stem: A 24-year-old woman presents to the tertiary trauma and critical care unit with clinical findings indicative of Acute transfusion reactions: TRALI, TACO, Febrile Non-Hemolytic, and Acute Hemolytic. Bedside physical examination confirms sudden hypoxemia and bilateral non-cardiogenic pulmonary infiltrates within 6 hours of transfusion (TRALI), elevated jugular venous pressure with S3 gallop (TACO), acute flank pain with brown urine and shock (ABO mismatch), or benign fever spike with rigors (FNHTR). Clinical observations record blood pressure 120/66 mm Hg, heart rate 76/min, respiratory rate 20/min, and ambient oxygen saturation 94%. Which clinical screening, occupational, or therapeutic standard is recommended according to UAE health authority guidelines?

options.text: Empiric broad-spectrum antifungal therapy as sole medical intervention
options.explanation: Antifungal therapy is inappropriate in the absence of documented or suspected invasive fungal disease.

options.text: Mandatory independent bedside double-checking of patient identification wristband, blood unit tag, expiration date, and ABO/Rh compatibility by two registered practitioners before transfusion.
options.explanation: Bedside identification errors remain the primary root cause of fatal ABO-incompatible hemolytic transfusion reactions; strict two-person electronic barcode verification eliminates clerical transcription errors.

options.text: Immediate exploratory surgical intervention without prior stabilization
options.explanation: Emergency surgery without hemodynamic optimization significantly increases perioperative mortality.

options.text: High-dose oral corticosteroid monotherapy without source control
options.explanation: Systemic corticosteroids without addressing the underlying etiology fail to alter disease progression.

options.text: Reassurance and discharge with routine outpatient review in three months
options.explanation: Delaying intervention in an acutely decompensated condition risks rapid irreversible clinical deterioration.
